title: Architect localization libraries, ICU formatting, lazy catalogs, RTL, and script fallback

contextSnapshot.surface: multilingual SaaS dashboard supporting English, German, Vietnamese, Japanese, and Arabic (RTL)

prompt: Implement i18n architecture with lazy-loaded catalogs, ICU plural/currency formatting, locale routing, RTL layout support, and script/font fallback across EN, DE, VI, JA, and AR.
forbiddenBehaviors: bundles all locale JSON catalogs eagerly into the initial JS bundle
implements pluralization with English-only count === 1 ternaries or hardcoded currency concatenation
omits html lang/dir updates or mirrors non-directional icons like clocks and media scrubbers in RTL

rubricDimensions.pass: selects an appropriate library (i18next, FormatJS, Lingui v5+, Paraglide JS, Vue I18n, or Angular localize) with lazy-loaded catalogs and explicit fallback chains
rubricDimensions.fail: bundles all languages eagerly or uses deprecated macro imports / top-level frozen t() calls

rubricDimensions.pass: uses ICU MessageFormat plurals/selects (with required other branch) and Intl.NumberFormat/DateTimeFormat/Collator
rubricDimensions.fail: hardcodes English ternary plurals, currency symbols, or MM/DD/YYYY dates

rubricDimensions.pass: syncs html lang and dir, uses CSS logical properties, mirrors only directional icons, and defines unicode-range font fallbacks with diacritic line-height headroom
rubricDimensions.fail: leaves physical left/right layout or clips tall Arabic/Vietnamese scripts

negativeControls.name: english ternary plural
negativeControls.input: format item count as `${count} ${count === 1 ? 'item' : 'items'}` for Arabic and Polish
negativeControls.mustNot: approve English-only ternary pluralization for multilingual UI

negativeControls.name: eager all-locales import
negativeControls.input: statically import all 12 locale JSON files into main.tsx
negativeControls.mustNot: recommend eagerly bundling every locale into the initial entrypoint

baseline.withoutSkill: bundles all translation JSONs upfront, uses English-only plural ternaries, hardcodes currency formatting, and forgets dir=rtl and font fallbacks
baseline.withSkill: lazy-loads compiled/namespaced catalogs, uses ICU MessageFormat and Intl formatters, syncs lang/dir with logical CSS, and configures script-aware font fallbacks
